```{r}
merge.all.disk.counts <- open_matrix_dir(dir = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge.all.disk")
meta <- readRDS("~/hpchome/meta.final.rds")
colnames(meta)[5] <- "barcode.simple"

metadata <- read_xlsx("CTCL_Metadata_Final_New.xlsx")
metadata$sample.merge <- ifelse(metadata$Sample %in% c(paste0("S",1:152)), metadata$Sample, metadata$Study.ID)
cell_meta <- meta %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% select(1:6, 9,11),
    by = c("orig.ident" = "sample.merge")
  )

cell_meta$orig.ident2 <- cell_meta$orig.ident
cell_meta$orig.ident <- cell_meta$Sample

table(cell_meta$Sample)

table(cell_meta$Patient.ID[cell_meta$orig.ident == "S240"])


rownames(cell_meta) <- make.unique(cell_meta$barcode)
cell_meta$barcode.sample <- paste0(cell_meta$barcode.simple.x, "_", cell_meta$Sample)
merge.all.disk@meta.data <- cell_meta

cell_meta$barcode <- paste0(cell_meta$barcode.simple, "_", cell_meta$orig.ident)
cell_meta$barcode.unique <- make.unique(cell_meta$barcode)
rownames(cell_meta) <- cell_meta$barcode.unique

saveRDS(cell_meta, "~/hpchome/cell_meta.rds")

colnames(merge.all.disk.counts) <- rownames(cell_meta)

merge.all.disk.counts@dimnames[[2]]
```

```{r}
merge.all.disk <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = merge.all.disk.counts, meta.data = cell_meta)

`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABGD][VDJ]", rownames(merge.all.disk), value = TRUE)
ig_genes  <- grep("^IG[HKL][VDJCMAG]", rownames(merge.all.disk), value = TRUE)
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(merge.all.disk), value = TRUE)

merge.all.disk <- NormalizeData(merge.all.disk)
merge.all.disk <- CellCycleScoring(merge.all.disk, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes)
merge.all.disk$cc.total <- merge.all.disk$S.Score + merge.all.disk$G2M.Score

merge.all.disk$percent.mt <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = merge.all.disk, pattern = "^MT-")
merge.all.disk$percent.rb <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = merge.all.disk, pattern = "^RP[SL]")
merge.all.disk$percent.hb <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = merge.all.disk, pattern = "^HB[AB]")

merge.all.disk <- subset(merge.all.disk, percent.mt < 20 & percent.rb < 60 & percent.hb <5)

merge.all.disk <- FindVariableFeatures(merge.all.disk)
vf <- VariableFeatures(merge.all.disk, nfeatures = 3000)
vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, hemoglobin))
VariableFeatures(merge.all.disk) <- vf.ss

merge.all.disk <- SketchData(object = merge.all.disk, ncells = 100000, method = "LeverageScore", sketched.assay = "sketch")

DefaultAssay(merge.all.disk) <- "sketch"

merge.all.disk <- FindVariableFeatures(merge.all.disk, nfeatures = 3000)
vf <- VariableFeatures(merge.all.disk)
vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, hemoglobin, s.genes, g2m.genes))
VariableFeatures(merge.all.disk) <- vf.ss

merge.all.disk <- ScaleData(merge.all.disk, vars.to.regress = c("cc.total", "percent.mt", "percent.rb"))
merge.all.disk <- RunPCA(merge.all.disk)
merge.all.disk <- RunHarmony(merge.all.disk, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "sketch", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
merge.all.disk <- RunUMAP(merge.all.disk, dims = 1:30, return.model = T, reduction = "harmony", umap.method = "umap-learn")

merge.all.disk <- FindNeighbors(merge.all.disk, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
merge.all.disk <- FindClusters(merge.all.disk, resolution = c(0.1,0.3,0.5))

merge.all.disk <- FindNeighbors(merge.all.disk, reduction = "umap", dims = 1:2)
merge.all.disk <- FindClusters(merge.all.disk, resolution = c(0.01,0.03,0.05))

DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.1", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.3", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.5", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.01", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.03", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.05", label = T)+NoLegend()
```

```{r}
Idents(merge.all.disk) <- merge.all.disk$sketch_snn_res.0.1
markers <- FindAllMarkers(merge.all.disk, only.pos = T, min.pct = .1, max.cells.per.ident = 5000)
markers$dif <- markers$pct.1 - markers$pct.2

markers.ss <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(dif)) %>% slice_head(n = 10)

merge.all.disk <- RenameIdents(merge.all.disk, "0" = "T_Cells",
                               "1" = "Fibroblasts",
                               "2" = "Keratinocytes",
                               "3" = "Myeloid",
                               "4" = "Vasc_Endo",
                               "5" = "T_Cells",
                               "6" = "Pericytes",
                               "7" = "B_Cells",
                               "8" = "Melanocytes",
                               "9" = "Lymph_Endo",
                               "10" = "Glandular_Epi",
                               "11" = "Mast_Cells",
                               "12" = "Keratinocytes",
                               "13" = "Neurons")

merge.all.disk$celltype <- Idents(merge.all.disk)

platelets <- CellSelector(DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend())

meta <- merge.all.disk@meta.data
meta$celltype <- as.character(meta$celltype)
meta$celltype[meta$barcode.unique %in% platelets] <- "Platelets"
merge.all.disk@meta.data <- meta
Idents(merge.all.disk) <- merge.all.disk$celltype
merge.all.disk$celltype <- Idents(merge.all.disk)

DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge.all.disk, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend()
```

```{r}
meta <- merge.all.disk@meta.data
meta <- meta[,-c(29:35)]
meta$celltype <- gsub("-", "_", meta$celltype)

meta$cloneSize <- droplevels(x = meta$cloneSize)
meta$cloneSize <- factor(
  meta$cloneSize,
  levels = c("Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)", "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)", "Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)",
             "Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)", "Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)"))
table(meta$cloneSize)

meta$hyper <- ifelse(meta$cloneSize == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)", "hyper", "non_hyper")
table(meta$hyper)
meta$hyper <- ifelse(is.na(meta$hyper), "missing", no = meta$hyper)
table(meta$hyper)

meta$has.tcr <- ifelse(is.na(meta$cloneSize), "No_TCR", "TCR")
meta$has.tcr.hyper <- ifelse(meta$has.tcr == "No_TCR", "No_TCR", meta$hyper)
table(meta$has.tcr.hyper, meta$has.tcr)

table(meta$Dx)
meta$Dx.simple <- ifelse(meta$Dx %in% c("SS", "MF", "FMF", "PCALCL"), "CTCL",
                         ifelse(meta$Dx == "HC", "HC", "BID"))
table(meta$Dx, meta$Dx.simple)

merge.all.disk@meta.data <- meta

```

```{r}
table(meta$hyper)

ncol(test.so)
```
